hero.headline: See the position before you calculate the move.
hero.support: A practical language for reading chess through constrained possibility, reachable states, pressure, boundaries, closure, defects, and repair. The aim is not to replace calculation, but to make clear what the calculation is for.

definition.title: A move is a state transition under adversarial constraint.
definition.body: A chess position is more than material and legal moves. It is a structured set of reachable continuations shaped by king safety, mobility, pressure, protection, time, geometry, tactical forcing, and the opponent's ability to answer.
definition.rule: Evaluate the move together with the future state it admits, closes, exposes, or makes irreversible.

positionLens.title: Read the boundary before choosing the line.

dimensions.name: Legality
dimensions.question: Which transitions are actually available now?

dimensions.name: King safety
dimensions.question: Which checks, mating nets, flight squares, pins, and exposed lines constrain the state space?

dimensions.name: Reachability
dimensions.question: Which squares, files, diagonals, ranks, and pieces can each side realistically activate in time?

dimensions.name: Pressure
dimensions.question: Which threats or overloaded duties remove otherwise legal continuations?

dimensions.name: Continuation
dimensions.question: After the candidate move and best reply, which useful options survive?

dimensions.name: Conversion / repair
dimensions.question: Can an advantage be stabilized, promoted, exchanged, or repaired before the opponent restores counterplay?

passes.name: 1. Bound the position
passes.question: What is forcing right now: checks, captures, threats, tactical liabilities, and immediate defensive obligations?

passes.name: 2. Map reachable pressure
passes.question: Which pieces and squares can become relevant within the next few moves, and which apparently available resources are too slow?

passes.name: 3. Generate candidate transitions
passes.question: Which moves materially change the boundary: open a line, close a square, trade a defender, create a passer, change king exposure, or force a reply?

passes.name: 4. Preserve continuation
passes.question: After the opponent's strongest answer, does the resulting state retain the coordination, safety, and options needed for the plan to continue?

passes.name: 5. Convert or repair
passes.question: If the move creates an advantage, can it be stabilized or promoted; if it creates a defect, what repair cost follows?

workedExample.title: Worked pattern: the material win that deletes the defense.
workedExample.setup: Imagine a candidate move that wins a rook or queen-side material but requires the only defender currently preventing a back-rank mating sequence to leave its post. The material count improves immediately; the reachable state space may become losing.
workedExample.naiveRead: The candidate wins material, so it is attractive.
boundaryRead: the defender is carrying two responsibilities, not one
moving it changes the set of legal defensive replies to a forcing check
the opponent's best answer may become forced rather than optional
the apparent material gain cannot be evaluated independently of king-safety closure
if the mating or decisive sequence is real, the move fails before conversion is relevant
workedExample.lesson: Boundary-First analysis does not replace calculation. It tells the calculation where the consequential boundary moved and which continuation must be falsified before the material gain can be trusted.
workedExample.scopeNote: This is a constructed teaching pattern rather than an engine-validated benchmark position.

validation.title: A teaching doctrine should earn its usefulness.
targets: recognition of overloaded defenders and hidden obligations
ability to explain why a move changes the reachable state space
transfer from tactical examples to positional continuation and conversion
agreement with established chess analysis on the actual position
validation.claimRule: Comparative teaching or performance claims require controlled evidence; explanatory fit to familiar chess motifs is not enough.

built: Worked explanatory grammar and teaching examples
proof.claimBoundary: The framework is offered for teaching, analysis, and falsification; it does not claim superiority to established chess instruction without comparative evidence.

claimBoundary.title: Practitioner doctrine, not a replacement for chess theory or engine analysis.
safe: Boundary-First Chess is a working public teaching and analysis doctrine.
Its vocabulary can be compared against established tactical, positional, endgame, and engine analysis.
The doctrine is useful only where it preserves the concrete rules and facts of the position.
notEstablished: that the doctrine improves rating or tournament performance
that it is superior to established coaching systems
that Boundary First terminology is necessary to explain positions already handled well by existing chess concepts
that illustrative patterns constitute engine or empirical validation

closing.title: Calculate the line. First understand which future you are trying to preserve.
closing.finalLine: Bound the position. Map the pressure. Test the reply. Preserve continuation. Convert only what survives.
